name: Wan 2.1 VACE + CausVid Pacing
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: For Wan 2.1 VACE 1.3B + CausVid 6-step rendering, specify ONE clear primary camera vector plus 1–2 physically grounded secondary motions (mist drift, cape flutter, light shimmer) rather than cramming chaotic multi-scene cuts into 4s windows.

name: Cross-Window Identity & Anchor Lock
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep clothing silhouette, face angle range, lighting color temperature, and background landmarks explicit across sliding window descriptions so end-frame -> next-window anchors do not drift.

name: Fabric & Hair Secondary Inertia
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Describe delayed physical follow-through: coat hem billowing backward after footsteps, loose hair strands lifting smoothly in crosswind, subtle sleeve creasing under shoulder swing.

name: High-Shutter Slow-Motion Physics
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Anchor slow-motion prompts on `120fps slow motion, crisp short shutter, suspended micro-droplets rotating slowly through air`, avoiding smeared low-shutter trails.

name: Ocean Swell & Crest Curl Motion
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Describe forward swell propagation smoothly folding into translucent turquoise lip, white crest spray aerosolizing into coastal wind, and receding foam lacing wet sand.

name: Rain Streaks & Puddle Impact Ripples
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep diagonal falling rain streaks varied by depth plane, add tiny concentric crown splashes erupting over lit puddles, and subtle umbrella runoff streams.

name: Buoyant Flame & Turbulent Plume
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Drive upward buoyant thermal acceleration: golden yellow flame base tapering into curling orange tongues and billowing semi-translucent smoke catching warm underside illumination.

name: Illuminated Sunbeam Dust Drift
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Add slow eddy-like floating dust motes catching tight golden shafts of sunlight across still interior air to give static environments unmistakable living depth.

name: Grounded Vehicle Pitch & Tire Spin
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep rubber tires touching clean ground shadows constantly while emphasizing subtle suspension body roll, spinning spoke blur, road reflection streaming past fenders, and steady camera chase spacing.

name: Natural Walk Cycle & Weight Shift
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Describe heel-to-toe weight transfer, natural gentle hip and shoulder counter-swing, confident relaxed arm cadence, and steady eye direction along travel vector.

name: Martial Anticipation & Follow-Through
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Break action cleanly into coiling anticipation, crisp directional blade/fist arc, dust/spark impact recoil, and balanced end-stance hold so Wan renders clear silhouette readability.

name: Subtle Breath, Blink & Gaze Shift
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep facial motion restrained and organic: calm chest rise on inhale, unhurried natural eyelid blink, subtle corner-of-mouth shift, and gentle head turn holding eye sharpness.

name: Alpine Mist & Dawn Cloud Glide
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Combine slow unwavering forward drone glide with silky valley mist cascading over rock saddles and warm sunrise light slowly brightening sharp granite and snow crests.

name: Layered Crowd Depth & Parallax
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep a softly defocused foreground passerby occasionally crossing edge of frame while hero remains anchored sharp and distant pedestrians stroll unhurriedly across background light.

name: Depth-Layered Wind Snowfall
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Layer large soft defocused foreground snowflakes crossing fast against thousands of tiny crisp mid-ground flakes illuminated inside warm streetlamp cones.

name: Practical Neon Pulse & Wet Glow
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Use subtle realistic voltage hum pulses in overhead glass signage synced with wet concrete reflection shimmer while keeping camera trajectory calm.

name: Accelerated Sunlight & Cloud Shadows
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep foreground architecture or ridgeline tripod-locked while fast-drifting cloud shadows sweep rhythmically over slopes and sky shifts amber to violet.

name: Laminar Liquid Pour & Swirl
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Focus on glossy continuous amber/crystal liquid ribbon curling smoothly into vessel, micro-bubbles forming along surface foam, and gentle steam tendrils lifting upward.

name: Wind Gust & Drifting Foliage
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Sway branch tips organically in unified gust waves while detached sakura petals or golden autumn leaves spiral gracefully across backlit depth.

name: Clean Parallax Without Texture Boil
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Avoid frantic multi-axis camera spinning; keep horizontal/forward velocity smooth and predictable so Wan preserves crisp wood, stone, and foliage micro-detail.

name: 4-Second Action Beat Architecture
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Write self-contained 4-second physical verbs per window (`enters doorway -> pauses -> turns under rain`) with explicit entry and exit states linking adjacent clips seamlessly.

name: DSLR Edge Crispness Over Smooth Blur
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Describe crisp tactile micro-surfaces (`granite facets, wool fibers, clean optical contrast, natural film dynamic range`), preventing muddy temporal over-smoothing.

name: Train Window Motion Contrast
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Hold passenger cabin seat and glass condensation tranquil inside frame while coastal cliffs or city lights streak horizontally outside the pane.

name: Zero-Gravity Momentum & Drift
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Convey frictionless conservation of momentum: slow gentle body rotation, floating tether slack, loose droplets, and harsh unfiltered directional sunlight against pitch black void.
